detail: Add bounded read-only CPU Profiler observer for existing debuggable APK, loopback-only disposable adb forward from owned public app PID/phase. Starts at native webview-login-catalog boundary, samples concurrently up to20s, stops/cleans before cold/roam/own-peer cleanup. Output fixed CPU kinds and five static owned compiled asset positions only; never raw profile, names, page text, provider URLs, account/body or errors. Existing actual UI90s/callback10s/media60s assertions and protected transport unchanged. Six tests cover privacy/native ancestor mapping/loopback/wire framing/size bounds; mandatory control selftests.
